units.source_text: 如果你誠實回答的話，我會酌情從寬處理。」

en.t: If you answer honestly, I will take that into account and treat you leniently.
Thank you. I appreciate your consideration.

units.source_text: 這種演技是對自己毫無益處可言的賣力表演。

en.t: It was an all-out performance that did me absolutely no good at all.

units.source_text: 天亮後，我被警察署長叫了出去，這一次是正式審訊。

en.t: After daybreak, I was summoned by the police chief; this time it was a formal interrogation.

units.source_text: 我推開門，腳還沒在署長室內站穩，署長便發話：「噢，長這麼帥呀。

en.t: I opened the door, and before I had even steadied myself inside the chief's office, he spoke: "Oh, what a handsome fellow."

units.source_text: 不是你的錯，是生下你這位帥哥的你媽媽的錯。」

en.t: It is not your fault; it is your mother's fault for giving birth to such a handsome man."

units.source_text: 這是一位面板黝黑，像剛走出大學不久的年輕署長。

en.t: He was a young police chief with dark skin, looking as though he had only recently left university.

units.source_text: 突然聽他這麼一說，我彷彿覺得自己半邊臉上長滿紅斑，是一個醜陋悲慘的殘疾人。

en.t: Hearing him say that so suddenly, I felt as though one half of my face were covered in red blotches, and I had become an ugly, miserable cripple.
